verdict.rationale: An AI-insights feature is a fair thing to ask of a merchant commerce platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced from merchant data inside the product. The MCP server only lets merchants query PayPal through their own external MCP clients, and the agent toolkit is a set of developer building blocks; the rest covers checkout, cart, and catalog plumbing for third-party AI shopping assistants.
